Method of Attack: Mobile clickfraud by faking user-agent strings to simulate iPhone devices
Downloader capabilities to fetch arbitrary files from developer's server
Launching at boot time and restarting after shutdown to maintain persistence
Simulating user interaction with ads in hidden browser windows to generate fraudulent ad clicks
Discoverer: Sophos Labs malware researcher Chen Yu
Attack Vector: Malicious Android apps distributed via Android marketplace
Command and control (C2) server communication to receive ad parameters and instructions
Indicators of Compromise: User-agent string: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 11_2_6 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/604.5.6 (KHTML, like Gecko) Mobile/15D100
